mostWorthwhile.text: Building the joint was worthwhile because the pictures showed how cartilage and fluid help the bone ends move, while ligaments provide support.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add bone cells directly to the reinforced fibres was confusing: the picture suggested they belonged together, but the attempt gave no explanation of what was needed first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the bone cells had to be combined with blood vessels first. The resulting picture showed nutrients reaching the cells through tiny channels.

arbitrary.text: The required order for adding bone cells felt somewhat arbitrary at first. Supplying the cells with blood made sense once shown, but the failed attempt did not explain that prerequisite.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: assembling the elbow made the different parts' jobs understandable, though I would hope for clearer feedback on prerequisites.
